messages:
maria: Heads-up: Acme's production calls to nebula-v3 saw p99 jump from ~1.8s -> ~7.4s after we onboarded the new tokenizer (txr-2) last night. Started ~02:10 UTC. Attach: customer curl + short log snippet.

maria: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"model":"nebula-v3","input":"<~12k tokens>"}'

maria: log snippet: 
```
request_id=acme-98765 model=nebula-v3 seq_len=11824 p95=2.1s p99=7.4s
tok_time=0.45s serve_time=6.7s kvcache_hit=false worker=gw-12
error_rate=0.0 latency_class=tail
```

ishaan: @maria can you paste a full profiler trace (tok vs decode vs kernel) and the exact tokenizer package version? txr-2 sounds like the new merge. Also any rate changes or batch config changes?

maria: tokenizer version=txr-2+patch. No traffic config changes on Acme side. Profiling from their repro run attached: 
```
profiler: tokenize=480ms decode=1800ms kernelexec=2100ms io_wait=120ms
kvcache_lookup=60ms kvcache_miss_count=43
```

ella: seeing similar numbers in canary yesterday during txr-2 rollout. Key observation: tokenize step jumped (subword merging changed) -> more subtokens for CJK and long hyphenated sequences. That increases seq_len and also causes KV cache fragmentation (different key shapes). Miss-rate → bigger decoder warmup.

ella: quick hypothesis: txr-2 alters boundary heuristics causing many small prefixes to be re-tokenized per request, preventing effective prefix/KV caching. Also some UTF-normalization changed which invalidates cached prefix keys.

ryan: mitigation plan (short): 1) route Acme to nebula-v3-legacy-tokenizer (pin older tokenizer) via rollout policy, 2) enable prefix-only caching for long-context requests, 3) temporarily lower max_concurrent_batch to avoid head-of-line decoding stalls, 4) schedule a canary rollback of txr-2 on next deploy if repro confirmed.

ryan: command to change routing (runbook):
```
# switch route for org Acme -> legacy tokenizer variant
redwood route update --org acme --model nebula-v3 --variant nebula-v3-legacy-tokenizer --reason "tokenizer txr-2 p99 regression"
```

maria: doing step 1 now. @deploy-bot please kick the policy change.

deploy-bot: Route update created: change-4538 queued -> applied to customer acme in 12s :white_check_mark:

support-bot: Ticket #12345 linked to thread. Alert: retries increased 3.6x; billing-increase-warning sent to finance@.

ishaan: after route change, can we get a rapid repro from Acme (same prompt) and compare profiler? If tok_time drops and kvcache_hit rises -> root cause confirmed. Also let's add a short-term regression alert on tokenizer package changes that looks for p99 delta >2x within 24h.

maria: Acme confirmed reduced p99 to 1.9s after routing to legacy variant. Will open a postmortem and roll txr-2 back on wider rollout until tokenizer heuristics are fixed.

ella: follow-ups: add a KV cache key-normalization step to make the cache resilient to minor UTF changes, add unit tests for long hyphenated sequences and multi-byte run-length, and update onboarding checklist to include a long-context p99 smoke test.

ryan: assigning action items: #4538 route change (done), #4539 rollback txr-2 (todo), #4540 KV cache normalization RFC (owner=ella). Leaving #12345 open until postmortem done.

maria: thanks all. I’ll update the customer and keep this thread for final notes. :pray:
